root_cause: Edge functions imported jsr: types at build time; a jsr.io timeout failed the whole function bundle for all previews.

actual_sources: workflow_run_logs supabase preview novbvfxewlesfgoniski, 2026-10-28 06:22 and 06:47 UTC: JSR package manifest for '@supabase/functions-js' timed out after 10s; failed to create the graph

fix: Removed the jsr: side-effect import from five functions; regression test forbids build-time jsr: imports.
prevention_rule: Edge functions must not depend on a non-npm registry being reachable during bundling; diagnose bundler failures from workflow logs before changing code.
terminal_rule: Not terminal until the Supabase Preview bundle for this PR succeeds.
